name: After § 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text: 3a. Condemns the fact that employers take advantage of this national environment hostile to trade unions to exploit their workers, particularly women and children; demands that European brands ensure that workers’ rights and in particular freedoms of association, expression and assembly, are protected in their supply chains; urges the Commission and the Member States to take action against companies operating in the EU that fail to meet their obligations regarding prevention, cessation, remedy and liability for human rights violations and environmental damage occurring in their supply chains, or that fail to adequately compensate victims;
